papers.title: Why Far Looks Up: Probing Spatial Representation in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether this reflects structured 3D understanding or reliance on statistical shortcuts. We introduce a representation-level analysis framework that constructs minimal contrastive pairs to measure how spatial axes are organized within VLM embeddings.

papers.title: EarlyTom: Early Token Compression Completes Fast Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding tasks. We propose EarlyTom, a training-free token compression framework that performs early-stage visual token compression inside the vision encoder, enabling 2.65x TTFT reduction and 61% FLOPs reduction.

papers.title: Xetrieval: Mechanistically Explaining Dense Retrieval
papers.abstract: Explaining why dense retrievers assign high relevance scores remains challenging. We propose Xetrieval, an embedding-level mechanistic framework that decomposes reasoning-enhanced embeddings into sparse, human-interpretable features each associated with a coherent natural language description.

papers.title: PRISM: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Peer Reviewers
papers.abstract: We introduce PRISM (Peer Review Intelligence via Structured Multi-dimensional assessment), a benchmarking framework evaluating review quality across Depth of Analysis, Novelty Assessment, Flaw Identification, and Multi-dimensional Constructiveness dimensions.

papers.title: When Cloud Agents Meet Device Agents: Lessons from Hybrid Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: We examine hybrid multi-agent systems combining on-device SLMs and cloud LLMs more systematically, studying how individual design choices shift the operating point along the Pareto frontier of power, cost, and performance.

papers.title: DynaFLIP: Rethinking Robotics Perception via Tri-Modal-Dynamics Guided Representation
papers.abstract: We introduce DynaFLIP, a dynamics-aware multimodal pre-training framework using image-language-3D flow triplets from heterogeneous human and robot videos, achieving +22.5% gains under out-of-distribution scenarios.

papers.title: REPOT: Recoverable Program-of-Thought via Checkpoint Repair
papers.abstract: We introduce RePoT (Recoverable PoT): a deterministic verified replay that walks the plan to its first invalid transition, then one LLM call resumes from the verified prefix. RePoT beats PoT by +3 to +11pp across four closed-model configurations.

papers.title: Multi-view Consistent 3D Gaussian Head Avatars 'without' Multi-view Generation
papers.abstract: We introduce MVCHead, a single-shot state space model enforcing multi-view consistency directly in 3D Gaussian representation without multi-view data or 3D supervision, achieving state-of-the-art perceptual quality.

papers.title: Geometry Matters: 3D Foundation Priors for Learning Semantic Correspondence
papers.abstract: We introduce a 3D-aware post-training framework incorporating priors from 3D foundation models for semantic correspondence. Our method uses SAM3D for geometry/pose estimation with render-and-compare optimization to complement DINO and Stable Diffusion features.

papers.title: Towards Consistent Video Geometry Estimation
papers.abstract: We present ViGeo, a feed-forward foundation model for spatially dense and temporally consistent geometry from video. Built on plain transformer with dynamic chunking attention, achieving state-of-the-art across online, offline, and long-video depth estimation.

cc_updates.body: Auto mode is now available on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.8. Opt in by setting `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE=1`

Plugins in `.claude/skills` directories are now automatically loaded. Added `claude plugin init <name>` to scaffold new plugins. `claude agents` now honors the `agent` field in `settings.json`. `EnterWorktree` can switch between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session. Fixed multiple issues with background sessions, sandbox permissions, and terminal rendering.
Fixed an issue when using Opus 4.8 where thinking blocks were modified, leading to API errors.
